title: Television: John Lennon and Yoko Ono on The Dick Cavett Show | 1971
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono appeared on The Dick Cavett Show on 8 September 1971.

Filming took place from 6pm at Studio 15 at the ABC Television Studios at 202 West 58th Street, Manhattan, New York City.

The couple was interviewed by Cavett, and excerpts from their films Fly and Erection were shown, as well as promotional clips for ‘Imagine’ and ‘Mrs Lennon’.

Lennon and Ono also took questions from the audience, and also reenacted a ‘Wall Street hooker’ sequence that had been shot for the Imagine film on 5 September. This time the scene was filmed near Washington Square Park at 27 West 8th Street.

The evening resulted in enough leftover footage for a subsequent episode of The Dick Cavett Show. Lennon and Ono returned to the show on 3 May 1972.
